description:
Hi everyone! We’re Haya Mahmoud and Zahra Hussain, third-year Software Engineering co-op students at the University of Guelph! 

We both love space, technology, and building creative projects that are fun and meaningful. We have experience in software development, programming, and working on real-world projects through our co-op experiences. We love brainstorming ideas, solving problems, and turning ambitious concepts into something people can actually use and enjoy!
